subject.title: Inject sibling agent list into session system prompt

question: Should OpenClaw expose sibling-agent roster metadata to model-visible session context, and should that exposure be automatic prompt text or a gated discovery-tool result?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes what operator-authored agent metadata and cross-agent permission state a model can see.

options.title: Prefer Gated Tool Discovery
options.body: Expose only authorized, bounded sibling metadata through `agents_list` or a similar discovery tool and avoid automatic prompt injection by default.

options.title: Inject Minimal Prompt Roster
options.body: Add compact prompt text for allowed siblings if maintainers accept the metadata exposure, token, and prompt-cache cost.

options.title: Reject Core Roster Exposure
options.body: Keep current id-only discovery plus explicit docs/config and close the broader model-visible roster request as outside the core context contract.

recommendation.title: Prefer Gated Tool Discovery
recommendation.body: Expose only authorized, bounded sibling metadata through `agents_list` or a similar discovery tool and avoid automatic prompt injection by default.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest history signal on `agents_list`, multi-agent routing, and the current prompt/tool boundary.
